messages:
alex: Quick handoff note before I sign off — lightweight watchlist for tonight (non-incident).

alex: TL;DR: No active incidents, but a couple of flaky alerts and a routing regression in eu-west-canary to keep an eye on. I'll be OOO after 21:30 UTC; marta is taking coverage.

marta: thanks — I saw the canary spikes earlier. what's the current mitigation?

alex: mitigation is automatic fallback to model-small when the canary's tail latency > 600ms. that's already enabled. main risk is false positives from decoder-worker timeouts that cause noisy paging.

jon: can you paste the query you used to surface the timeout cluster? want to add to my dashboard quick check.

alex: sure — run: 
```
SELECT node, count(*) as errors FROM infra.logs
WHERE service = 'decoder-worker' AND error LIKE '%context deadline exceeded%'
AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY node ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 50;
```

the pattern is concentrated on encoder-12 and decoder-7.

sam: noting that encoder-12 also had a pod restart at 2026-02-14T19:02:11Z but it passed healthchecks quickly — probably transient. I bumped its drain threshold to 90s to avoid cascade.

marta: got it. I'll watch those two nodes and mute the noisy alert if it keeps firing while we investigate. what alert channel should we mute?

alex: alert name is `decoder_worker_timeout_high`. mute scope = `eu-west-canary` for 30m if >3 alerts in 10m. add a note: "muted during handoff for investigation".

oncall-bot: alert summary (last 2h): decoder_worker_timeout_high: 7 fires (eu-west-canary: 5), kv-prefetch-latency: 3 fires, prefix-cache-fuzz: 1 fire.

marta: doing a manual check on regen queues now. if I see sustained backlog > 200 I'll escalate.

jon: quick CR ping — I left comments on PR #4624 (routing policy) re: fallback priorities. If we merge that before morning it'll reduce fallback-to-small churn.

sam: FYI: I'm running a canary deploy of the 3pm runtime tweak to one pool (canary-id: c-71). Logs look ok so far but will watch for token-rate regressions.

marta: thanks. I'll add c-71 to the handoff list and keep a check every 15m.

alex: small checklist for tonight's handover: 
- mute rule ready for decoder_worker_timeout_high
- watch nodes: encoder-12, decoder-7
- monitor canary c-71 and eu-west-canary routing latency
- ping on PR #4624 if any fallback churn appears

marta: copying checklist into notes. if anything hits, @jon and @sam are on pager backup. I'll update thread with any muting + why. :white_check_mark:

jon: thanks team. quick note — undergrad infra training tomorrow morning, so avoid scheduling noisy experiments between 09:00–11:00 UTC.

alex: noted. signing off now. handing to marta. good luck all. :v:
